rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Pincer is a security-focused gateway that addresses credential exposure risks in agentic systems. Instead of giving agents direct access to API keys and database passwords, Pincer issues ephemeral proxy tokens while maintaining encrypted mappings to real secrets. Features hardware-backed cryptography through OS keychains, just-in-time decryption, memory scrubbing, and tamper-evident audit logging with SHA-256 chain-hashing. Supports Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
